description: Na₂VP₂O₈ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4bm space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.59-2.84 Å. V is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There is one shorter (1.63 Å) and four longer (1.99 Å) V-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.64 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent P atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three equivalent Na and one P atom.
